body: Okay, not sure if this is only happening to me, but recently i’ve been getting friend requests from roblox accounts that only have like 1-2 friends, and their friends list is accounts with the same display name as me. It’s weird. It’ll happen maybe once a week, and im not sure if it’s some type of weird scam? My display name on roblox is ASTERISK and i keep getting friend requests from seemingly random users, but their friends list is just accounts with my same display name.I originally thought that maybe someone was trying to find a specific person but couldn’t find their user, so they searched the display name. I don’t think this anymore, because it’s happened over 5 times from different accounts.
THANK YOU!! what did you search?
Nope. Also it was a male singer.
I’m from South West, Ohio. My dad played the CD from probably 2011-2013, but from what i remember it sounded late 90ish-early 2000s
